content.comment_body: Hello everyone, When I connect a wire to the 9th input terminal of the [product_name] device ([article_no]), the screen turns off. The module receives the input, but no information appears on the display. Does anyone have suggestions to keep the display active? Best regards, [user_name]
Hello. Ensure you are correctly connecting the expansion module to the [product_name] device. The details in the attached document may be helpful.

You might be using flag 27, which switches to the alternate character set on the display. Without configuring messages for it, the display may appear blank or show a default empty message. Hope this is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter an issue where wiring to the 9th input of a [product_name] device causes the display to go blank, despite proper input detection. Suggestions include verifying wiring and checking related configuration flags that might affect display behavior. The main concern is the unclear status of the device when the display does not show messages.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the display to stay on and present status messages whenever a new input is connected, regardless of which terminal is used.
